_doc.v1: v1 reproduced exactly (Kaggle, MultiOutputClassifier, argmax decode, 75/25 split rs=0). zero_fire_pct / multi_fire_pct = % of 550 test rows where no / >1 one-vs-rest head fires; pred_class0_pct = % predicted as class 0 (apple).
_doc.v1_fixed: same estimators as plain multiclass models: same split, and StratifiedKFold(5) on the full Kaggle set.
_doc.dataset: audit of the merged v2 set from backend/app/data_loader.load_dataset().
_doc.models: StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle, rs=42) on merged v2 data, features = 7 numerics + one-hot soil/season/state. *_mean/*_std over folds. train_rows_cap = training-fold subsample size (null = full fold). oof_accuracy_<source> = out-of-fold accuracy on that source's rows.
_doc.app_protocol: the backend's own 80/20 split re-run for the deployed RF.
_doc.ablation: deployed RF config, same folds, different categorical feature sets.
_doc.loso: key 'held_out|variant'. Train on two sources, test on the third restricted to crops seen in training. open set = all train crops; numeric only = no categorical features; closed set = training restricted to shared crops.
_doc.leave_states_out: multi-state source only, GroupKFold(4) by state vs StratifiedKFold(4).
_doc.importance: permutation importance (accuracy drop), deployed RF, 5,000 test rows, 5 repeats.
_doc.calibration: top-1 reliability on the app test split, 15 bins. ece = expected calibration error; brier = multiclass Brier score.
_doc.mcnemar: paired v1-fixed (RF on Kaggle rows, 7 numerics) vs v2 on the same test rows; b = v1 right & v2 wrong, c = v1 wrong & v2 right; p_exact = exact binomial test.
_doc.improvement: v1 -> v2 summary table (array of rows).

meta.doc: hit1 = top-ranked crop is one of the recommend==1 crops of the district-year-season query; hit3 = any of the top 3 is; recall3 = share of recommended crops in the top 3. leave_districts_out = GroupKFold(5) by state|district; leave_states_out = GroupKFold(5) by state (state feature dropped); leave_years_out = train <=2014, test >=2015.

v4._doc: CC5 novel method: yield-grounded crop ranking (YieldRank, LightGBM LambdaMART) + split-conformal sets on DES district x season x year data. Written by experiments/report.py. v4.numbers holds exactly the values of paper/tables/numbers.tex (same names, as printed in the paper); use them for any displayed figure. v4.conformal = YieldRank 90%/80% sets per protocol and calibration (fractions). Hit@1 = top-ranked crop is the best-yielding one.
